content:
Samir Gupta: Hi team, new ask from BeaconHealth POC. They need: ISO27001 cert copy, SOC2 attestation + control mapping for POC scope, a signed pen-test engagement letter for a 2-week window, and temporary staging access (IP allowlist). Also asked for a very rough Dedicated vs hosted cost delta so procurement can approve. Timeline: they want everything by next Tue. Any immediate no-gos?

Lena Torres: ISO copy = we can share certificate PDF and scope page (redacted). We should include a short control mapping doc that maps our controls to their questionnaire sections. I can draft that.

Noah Kim: Pen-test: we have an attestation letter from our vendor (Pentestify) and we can sign a scoped engagement letter for their external tests. We DO NOT provide raw reports. If Beacon requests specific CVs for vendor testers, legal needs to ok.

Rashmi Singh: Staging access: infra needs a ticket with customer IPs + intended tests (e.g., load test, auth flows, red team). We can provision project `beacon-poc-stage` in us-west1 and create `svc-beacon-poc` with minimal roles. Note: websocket streaming endpoints are behind NLB in that cluster; include `need_streaming: yes/no`.

Olivia Martin: Pricing note: short ballpark for single A100-class Dedicated = $18k-$22k/mo list depending on commit; hosted for POC (burst) estimated $6k-$10k for heavy token runs but unpredictable. I'll add a one-line caveat for seq len and sustained RPS.

Samir Gupta: Good. Lena, can you prepare ISO + control mapping and upload to secure share? Noah, drop the pen-test template and the vendor attestation. Rashmi, post infra ticket template. Olivia, one-line pricing bullet. I'll bundle and send to Beacon.

Lena Torres: Uploaded: `ISO27001_cert_2023.pdf` and `control_mapping_beacon.xlsx` to secure share (link: https://internal.redwood.com/share/beacon-poc). Redaction notes included.

Noah Kim: Pen-test attestation and engagement template uploaded. Template includes scope stub and rules of engagement. Legal turnaround ~48h for redlines.

Rashmi Singh: Infra ticket template posted. Snippet: ```Customer: BeaconHealth
Contact: name/email
IPs: 203.0.113.45/32, 198.51.100.0/24
Project: beacon-poc-stage
Service account: svc-beacon-poc-2024
Roles: infer-only
Streaming: yes
Token TTL: 14d
Start: 2024-07-01
End: 2024-07-15``` Ping me when you open it, I can expedite.

Olivia Martin: Price bullets: Dedicated single node (A100-class): $20k/mo list (1-mo POC quote available); Hosted burst estimate for 2-week POC load test: ~$8k expected. Both dependent on seq len and token volume.

Samir Gupta: One more ask from Beacon: they want to include a clause that any critical vulnerabilities discovered during their red team will be shared via a joint disclosure cadence. We'll need legal input. I'll flag Legal and Security if they confirm.

Lena Torres: Noted. I can add a line in the control mapping about incident response contacts.

Noah Kim: If they run scheduled active tests, require a scheduled blackout and notify `security@redwood.com`. Add to engagement letter.

Rashmi Singh: Also call out rate limits on the staging cluster. If they plan sustained high QPS, talk to Mateo for capacity.

Olivia Martin: ack. I'll draft the 1-pager quote and attach assumptions (seq len, avg tokens/req).

Samir Gupta: Thanks. I'll consolidate and send to Beacon. If Beacon asks for deeper evidence (logs, ticket histories) we'll escalate to Legal.

Lena Torres: ack.

Noah Kim: ack.

Rashmi Singh: ack.

Olivia Martin: ack.
